attacks.name: Hidden Power
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If tails, put 2 damage counters on 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hidden Power
attacks.text: Choose a card from your hand and put it face down. Your opponent guesses if the card is a Pokémon, Trainer, or Energy card. Reveal the card. If your opponent guessed wrong, draw 2 cards. Put the card back into your hand.
